name: Perafensine
summary: Perafensine (INN; development code HR-459) is a drug which was investigated as an antidepressant but was never marketed. It has been reported to antagonize the effects of reserpine and to inhibit the reuptake of norepinephrine (norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor); whether it also affects the reuptake of serotonin or dopamine is unclear.

pharmacology.text: It has been reported to antagonize the effects of reserpine and to inhibit the reuptake of norepinephrine (norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor); whether it also affects the reuptake of serotonin or dopamine is unclear.

uses.text: Perafensine (INN; development code HR-459) is a drug which was investigated as an antidepressant but was never marketed.

fact.en: It was tested by its ability to block the effects of reserpine, a plant alkaloid that empties nerve cells of their messengers. That test was a standard way to screen for antidepressants.
fact.zh: 它的測試方式是看它能否阻斷蛇根鹼的作用；蛇根鹼是一種植物生物鹼，會把神經細胞中的傳訊物質排空。這個測試曾是篩選抗憂鬱藥的標準方法。
fact.zhHans: 它的测试方式是看它能否阻断蛇根碱的作用；蛇根碱是一种植物生物碱，会把神经细胞中的传讯物质排空。这个测试曾是筛选抗忧郁药的标准方法。
